notes:
SALMON VS サーモン:
- サーモン - typically refers to Atlantic salmon (⟦{養殖|ようしょく}→養殖：08648_youshoku⟧ farmed salmon) used for sushi/sashimi
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧/{鮭|しゃけ} - refers to Pacific salmon, often cooked rather than eaten raw

COMMON DISHES:
- サーモン⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧ - salmon sushi
- サーモン{丼|どん} - salmon rice bowl
- サーモン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ - salmon sashimi
- スモークサーモン - smoked salmon
- サーモンマリネ - marinated salmon

SUSHI CONTEXT:
サーモン is one of the most popular sushi toppings in Japan, especially at ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧ (conveyor belt sushi) restaurants. It was not traditionally used in Edo-style sushi but became popular in the 1980s-90s.

TYPES:
- アトランティックサーモン - Atlantic salmon
- キングサーモン - King salmon
- トラウトサーモン - trout salmon
